prompts.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: full-height portrait hero photograph for a premium Russian hair salon editorial website. Primary request: high-end understated fashion beauty photograph of an adult woman with extraordinarily beautiful long rich dark brunette hair, softly sculpted large natural waves. Subject shown from mid upper-arm upward, in three-quarter profile, looking down slightly towards the left of frame with calm self-possession. Wearing simple black sleeveless top, natural subtle makeup, authentic skin texture. Hair is the hero, voluminous and lustrous, falling over her right shoulder and taking much of the right and bottom image. Composition vertical 4:5, head fully in frame with some negative space above, body centered slightly to the right; elegant silhouette, not commercial smiling stock photo. Warm olive taupe textured studio backdrop. Side lighting like late afternoon sunlight from upper left, dramatic soft shadows, warm analog film tones, quiet luxury editorial photography, medium format lens, extremely refined art direction. Colors warm chestnut, deep espresso, muted beige, olive. No text, no lettering, no collage, no border, no jewelry, no logos, no watermark. Save output file to local disk and return its local path if supported.
